description: A sensor profile (design doc §9.1; M6 spec claim 10): what it watches (an edge: a face crossed; a volume: cells entered; a credential: a locked door's flagged check), whether a trip goes out on the site squad's radio, and whether it can be spoofed; a spoofable sensor says how much hacking work a spoof takes (milli-units of device memory a tick, as a terminal's hack_work) the device tag it requires, and how many ticks it then stays quiet (M6 spec claim 12).
